prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for choose_path layout changes, finish notifications, and sign_in reordering, as each has only been tested once.
Predictions were consistently too optimistic across all tested changes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, layout: -3.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Grid Layout for Path Selection Screen: Redesign the choose_path screen with a grid layout displaying clear visual path options to help users compare tracks quickly. (why: The choose_path step has a 76.2% conversion rate and a high mean time of 514s, indicating that users hesitate when reviewing options.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Personality Selection Screen: Add a new screen called new_personality right after pick_friend where users select their pet's core temperament before proceeding. (why: Adoption stage drops to 60.9% conversion with a 1017s mean duration; adding clear personality options increases structured personalization.)
2: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Desktop Controls Overview on Finish Screen: Redesign the home_intro screen using a spotlight layout highlighting taskbar controls and basic desktop pet commands. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and support received multiple queries asking how to control, hide, or talk to pets after setup.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Sync Reassurance Hint: Display a hint on the sign_in screen explaining that signing in syncs pets and prevents data loss. (why: Sign_in drops to 72.9% with a 567s mean duration, and 8 support tickets cited missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [adoption, layout] Stage Layout for Adoption Certificate: Change the adoption_certificate screen layout to stage view for a prominent confirmation experience. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the main funnel (60.9%) and long average completion times (1017s mean).)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Environment Status display on Waiting Screen: Show explicit status text and time estimate on the waiting screen while background assets render. (why: The home stage shows high drop-off (81.3%) and very high average duration (2336s mean), while 3 support tickets noted desktop rendering failures.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Welcome Story Value Proposition Copy: Update the story screen headline and body copy to emphasize quick set up and direct desktop companionship. (why: The choose_path stage mean time of 514s indicates initial user hesitation; clearer introductory expectations will improve flow momentum.)
7: [finish, new_flow] Post-Onboarding Quick Start Checklist Flow: Insert a new screen called new_quick_start between waiting and home_intro formatted as a interactive checklist for basic pet shortcuts. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion on controlling or hiding pets, and finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.)
8: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Clarification Copy: Update the headline and body text on sign_in to clarify how credentials link to local desktop profiles. (why: Support received 8 reports of missing pets after re-authenticating and 2 reports of sign-in stalls.)
9: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Banner on Waiting Screen: Enable desktop readiness notifications on the waiting screen so users know when background setup finishes. (why: The home stage median is 201s but mean is 2336s, indicating many users switch away while waiting for rendering to complete.)
